abstract: A 17-year-old woman was suddenly seized with anterior chest pain and admitted to our hospital. Chest X-ray, computed tomography (CT) scan and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) showed a mass shadow in the left middle lung field associated with the left pleural effusion and high serum carbohydrate antigen 19-9 (CA 19-9) levels (58.5 U/ml). We performed a total resection of the tumor with adherent parts of the left lung. The tumor was 6.5 x 3. 8 x 2.9 cm in size, and was made up of soft tissues, fluid and cystic components. The histological diagnosis was a mature cystic teratoma with perforation into the lung, which contained pancreatic tissues, hepatic cells, bronchial epithelium, serous glands and so on. The levels of fluid amylase and CA 19-9 were high. We report mediastinal mature teratoma perforating into the lung and discuss the mechanism of perforation.
abstract_ja: 17歳の女性が突然前胸部痛を訴えて入院した。胸部X線、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)、磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で左肺中野に腫瘤影を認め、左胸水および血清CA 19-9高値(58.5 U/ml)を伴っていた。隣接する左肺の一部とともに腫瘍の外科的切除を行った。腫瘍は6.5 x 3.8 x 2.9 cmで、軟部組織、液体、嚢胞成分から構成されていた。組織学的診断は肺へ穿破した成熟嚢胞性奇形腫であり、膵組織、肝細胞、気管支上皮、漿液腺などを含んでいた。胸水のアミラーゼおよびCA 19-9値は高値であった。縦隔成熟奇形腫が肺へ穿破する機序について考察した。
